eyecon-caller-id-&-spam-block.description: Full-Screen Caller ID, Block Spam Calls, Reverse Lookup, and Toki Walkie-Talkie Feature. Want full control over your incoming calls? Eyecon is the perfect solution for displaying Caller ID and blocking spam calls. With Eyecon, you can see a caller’s photo on full-screen, identify unknown numbers, and easily block unwanted calls. The Toki Walkie-Talkie feature allows instant voice communication with friends and family, while the reverse lookup feature provides detailed information on unknown numbers.
